rationale: The agent authenticated the user and appears to have looked up the user’s orders, but it failed two key policy requirements and did not fully complete the user’s request. First, it submitted the return request without explicit user confirmation, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Second, it did not answer the user’s question about how many t-shirt options are available in the store. While the agent mentioned refund details and an email confirmation, it omitted the t-shirt count and executed a write action without prior confirmation, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
